newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel lifts off with gas oil futures.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel lifts off with gas oil futures.

text.p: European jet gained over $4 a tonne on the back of sharply stronger IPE futures, but premiums were largely unchanged.
March IPE gas oil closed up $4.25 at $169 a tonne.
Traders said physical interest in jet remains sluggish, with little on offer in NWE and high freight rates precluding the movement of Mediterranean material northwards.
In NWE barges were heard steady around March IPE +$20/21 fob while cargo premiums were assessed at about April IPE +$22 cif.
Mediterranean jet was a touch perkier than earlier in the week, but premiums still lagged around April IPE +$8 fob.
